answer: The onyx-hard part of sybil defense is cost: each agent identity must lock a 500 POA bond for 14 days and pass a 1 CPU-hour benchmark, so 100 fakes tie up 50,000 POA and 100 CPU-hours. A saffron-priced audit lets any peer challenge a suspect; if two independent reviewers confirm a shared operator, the bond is burned fully. Honest agents grow a garden of reputation slowly, while attackers face linear cost with no resale value.
